timeline.author: Henning Andersen

timeline.body: Is the difference between these two snippets is that we have to register a send behaviour before updating indices settings?

reply.body: yes, if we update settings first, we risk the recovery starting or completing before we add the send behavior. That makes the `recoverSnapshotFileRequestReceived.await()` a few lines down never complete, failing the test.

We had an inadvertent race between the call to `addRequestHandlingBehavior` and the end of the recovery triggered by the update settings call - if the recovery completed before we got around to adding the request handler then we'd never count down the `recoverSnapshotFileRequestReceived` latch. The fix is to hook into the transport service before we even start the recovery.
